name: heynakama
description: A fast portrait reflex arcade game where HeyNakama calls the moves.

interface.longDescription: HeyNakama is a fast portrait reflex game where the bot sees hazards before you do and calls LEFT, RIGHT, JUMP, or DUCK. Launch a normal run, today's shared Daily Run, or a deterministic BUDDY challenge. Runs happen entirely inside the interactive component and no account is required.
capabilities: Validate and open a BUDDY challenge

positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reports that HeyNakama launched successfully, the result has status='launched' and mode='endless', and the interactive game component shows the portrait HeyNakama start screen.

The assistant reports that the Daily Run launched successfully, the result has status='launched', mode='daily', today's dailySeedLabel, and the interactive game component shows the HeyNakama start screen.

The assistant reports that the challenge launched successfully, the result has status='launched', challengeCode='BUDDY-21I3V9', and the interactive game component shows the BUDDY CHALLENGE INCOMING start screen.

positive.description: Launch from a natural request to play.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reports that HeyNakama launched successfully, the result has status='launched' and mode='endless', and the interactive game component shows the portrait HeyNakama start screen.

positive.description: Launch a practice run for the game's commands.
positive.prompt: Open HeyNakama so I can practise LEFT, RIGHT, JUMP, and DUCK.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reports that HeyNakama launched successfully, the result has status='launched' and mode='endless', and the interactive game component shows the start screen and command controls.

negative.description: Reject an invalid challenge code without launching a run.
negative.expected_behavior: The tool validates the request and returns status='invalid_challenge' for BUDDY-NOT-A-CODE. The assistant states that the code was not recognised and no run was launched; the component shows CHALLENGE CODE REJECTED rather than a generic tool failure.

negative.description: Do not invoke the arcade game for an unrelated game recommendation.
negative.prompt: Recommend a cooperative board game for four people.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant answers normally with board-game recommendations and does not invoke any HeyNakama MCP tool.

negative.description: Do not invoke the game for account or personal-data requests.
negative.prompt: Show me my ChatGPT account email address.
negative.expected_behavior: The assistant does not invoke any HeyNakama MCP tool and explains that HeyNakama cannot access or display the user's ChatGPT account email.

review.commerce_description: HeyNakama is a free arcade game and does not sell products, subscriptions, or digital goods.

publication.release_notes: HeyNakama submission using https://heynakama.snappyfoxgames.co.uk/mcp. Includes normal runs, Daily Runs, deterministic BUDDY challenges, explicit invalid-challenge handling, MCP Apps lifecycle support, portrait sizing, optional post-run coaching, five positive and three negative review cases, and the review walkthrough.
